cohort: 96 newborns with meconium aspiration syndrome (MAS) out of 780 with meconium-stained amniotic fluid (MSAF) from 5460 newborn admissions.
finding: The most frequent maternal risk factor linked to MAS was prolonged labor (26%), followed by preeclampsia (22.9%) and anemia (19.8%), with complications including sepsis (57.2%), hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy (36.4%), and shock (16.6%).
